scripts.predev: node -e "try{const v=require('vite/package.json').version;const major=parseInt((v||'0').split('.')[0],10);if(major!==4){console.error('Vite '+v+' detected; requires v4.x.');process.exit(1)};console.log('[predev] vite',v)}catch(e){console.warn('[predev] Local vite not found; the launcher will fall back to npx vite@4.5.3') }"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');try{const pkgPath=require.resolve('vite/package.json');const vite=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(pkgPath,'utf8')).version;const ok=/^4\./.test(vite);if(!ok){console.error('[postinstall] vite '+vite+' is not v4.x (will not block dev). Ensure vite@4.5.3 in CI.');}try{fs.rmSync(path.join('node_modules','.vite'),{recursive:true,force:true});}catch{}try{fs.rmSync('.vite',{recursive:true,force:true});}catch{}console.log('[postinstall] Purged .vite caches');}catch(e){console.warn('[postinstall] Local vite not present yet; skipping verification.')}"
scripts.prestart: node -e "try{require('fs').rmSync('node_modules/.vite',{recursive:true,force:true});require('fs').rmSync('.vite',{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('[prestart] Purged Vite caches')}catch(e){console.warn('[prestart] No Vite cache to purge')}"
scripts.dev:purge-cache: node -e "try{require('fs').rmSync('node_modules/.vite',{recursive:true,force:true});require('fs').rmSync('.vite',{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('Purged Vite caches')}catch(e){console.warn('No Vite cache to purge')}" && node scripts/run-vite-local.js -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
